research_question: How stable are the paper-one dimension rankings across seeds, pricing geometries, asset families, and the Core-92 versus Core-86 data definitions?

fixed_reporting_statistics.geometry_surface: For every data definition, asset family, K, gamma, and seed, report the frozen distance, five-seed mean, standard error, and rank.
fixed_reporting_statistics.endpoint_stability: At gamma 0 and gamma 1, report the best-K frequency across the five fixed seeds and the five-seed-mean rank.
fixed_reporting_statistics.data_definition_sensitivity: For the three common primary asset sets, report Core-92 versus Core-86 Spearman and Kendall rank agreement across the six K values at every frozen gamma, plus exact best-K agreement.
fixed_reporting_statistics.external_assets: Report the frozen point estimates and existing 12-month block-bootstrap intervals for A, market-direction attenuation, and K=1 plus market completion.
fixed_reporting_statistics.mechanism: Report the already-frozen spectral concentration, market hedge, and factor-completion diagnostics without adding a new decision rule.
fixed_reporting_statistics.subperiods: Report all already-frozen 2010-2014 and 2015-2019 external-family results.

artifact_plan.tables: Canonical CSV long tables plus LaTeX publication tables.
artifact_plan.figures: PDF, SVG, and 300-dpi PNG generated from the canonical CSV tables.
artifact_plan.manifest: SHA-256 manifest for every input and generated artifact.

interpretation_rule: All V023 statistics are descriptive reporting or robustness diagnostics. They may qualify uncertainty and data-definition sensitivity but cannot replace or rescue a failed V022 primary rule.
stopping_rule: Generate the complete fixed artifact set once, correct only code or labeling errors, and retain superseded manifests. Do not add dimensions, assets, model variants, hyperparameters, or sealed-period outputs.
